findings.message: #music has data-volume="0.28" (-11.1 dB) and a GSAP tween on `volume`. Tween values are absolute: they REPLACE this gain rather than scale it, so wherever the tween names a value the clip plays at that value, not at -11.1 dB.
findings.fixHint: Write the tween's targets in the same absolute gain (e.g. `volume: 1.95`, not `volume: 1`), or reset data-volume to 1 and let the tween carry the level on its own.

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#noise-knob" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left with the transform equivalent (x), e.g. tl.fromTo("#noise-knob", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: <section id="intro-stage"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="intro-halo">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="intro-stage"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
